title: Venting Doesn\x26#39;t Reduce Anger, But Something Else Does, Says Study
titleZh: 一项大型研究揭示控制脾气的科学新途径
summary:
该研究的资深作者、传播学科学家布拉德·布什曼在去年公布研究结果时表示：“我认为我们很有必要打破‘愤怒时就该尽情发泄——把气全部发出来’这种错误观念。宣泄愤怒听起来似乎很合理，但并没有任何科学证据能够支持所谓的情绪宣泄理论。”

来源：科学警告；作者：Russell McLendon；原文发布时间：2025-08-10 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: "I think it's really important to bust the myth that if you're angry you should blow off steam – get it off your chest," said senior author and communication scientist Brad Bushman when the results were published last year. "Venting anger might sound like a good idea, but there's not a shred of scientific evidence to support catharsis theory."
paragraphs.contentZh: 该研究的资深作者、传播学科学家布拉德·布什曼在去年公布研究结果时表示：“我认为我们很有必要打破‘愤怒时就该尽情发泄——把气全部发出来’这种错误观念。宣泄愤怒听起来似乎很合理，但并没有任何科学证据能够支持所谓的情绪宣泄理论。”

paragraphs.contentEn: That doesn't mean anger should be ignored. Reflection can help us understand why we get mad and address underlying problems. It can also aid emotional validation, an important first step towards healthily processing emotions. Venting, however, often goes beyond reflection into rumination. The study suggests that many people also try to exorcize anger with physical exertion, which can offer health benefits but may not lighten the mood in the moment.
paragraphs.contentZh: 当然，这并不意味着愤怒应当被压抑或忽视。反思能够帮助我们理解自己为什么生气，并着手解决背后的根本问题。同时也能促进情绪的自我认可，这是健康处理情绪的关键第一步。相比之下，宣泄往往会从反思滑向对情绪的反复纠结。研究还发现，许多人尝试通过体力活动来释放怒气，这种方式虽然对身体健康有益，却未必能立即改善情绪状态。

paragraphs.contentEn: The studies reviewed included a total of 10,189 participants, representing a variety of ages, genders, cultures, and ethnicities. The findings show the key to curbing anger is reducing physiological arousal, the authors say, from anger itself or from the otherwise beneficial physical activity it might inspire. "To reduce anger, it is better to engage in activities that decrease arousal levels," Bushman said. "Despite what popular wisdom may suggest, even going for a run is not an effective strategy because it increases arousal levels and ends up being counterproductive."
paragraphs.contentZh: 这项元分析研究共纳入10189名参与者，覆盖不同年龄、性别、文化背景和族裔群体。研究作者指出，平息愤怒的关键在于降低生理唤醒水平，无论这种唤醒来自愤怒本身，还是由愤怒引发的、在其他方面有益的体育活动。布什曼表示：“要想平复情绪，最好选择能降低唤醒水平的活动。虽然人们普遍认为跑步有助于发泄怒气，但其实不是，因为跑步会提高生理唤醒，反而适得其反。”

paragraphs.contentEn: The research was inspired partly by the popularity of 'rage rooms', where people pay to smash objects in hopes of releasing anger, said first author Sophie Kjærvik, a communication scientist at Virginia Commonwealth University. "I wanted to debunk the whole theory of expressing anger as a way of coping with it," explained Kjærvik. "We wanted to show that reducing arousal, and actually the physiological aspect of it, is really important."
paragraphs.contentZh: 该研究的第一作者、弗吉尼亚联邦大学传播学科学家索菲·凯尔维克表示，这项研究的灵感部分源于近年来流行的“愤怒宣泄室”，人们付费进入房间，通过砸碎物品来尝试释放怒气。凯尔维克解释说：“我希望能彻底推翻‘通过表达愤怒来处理情绪’的传统理论。我们想证明，降低唤醒水平，特别是生理层面的唤醒，才是缓解愤怒的关键所在。”

paragraphs.contentEn: The team designed the review based on the Schachter-Singer two-factor theory, which describes anger (and all other emotions) as a two-part phenomenon, each comprising a physiological and a cognitive component. Previous research has often focused on the cognitive angle, according to Kjærvik and Bushman, like examining how cognitive behavioral therapy can help people adjust the mental meanings underpinning their anger. Research shows that can work, they say, but the review also sheds important light on an alternate pathway for defusing fury. What's more, standard cognitive behavioral therapies are not effective for all brain types.
paragraphs.contentZh: 研究团队基于“沙赫特-辛格双因素理论”设计了这项元分析研究，该理论认为，愤怒（以及其他所有情绪）由两个基本要素构成：生理唤醒与认知解释。凯尔维克和布什曼指出，过去的研究大多聚焦于认知层面，例如探讨认知行为疗法如何帮助人们重构愤怒背后的心理认知。他们表示，这种方法确实有效，但此次研究还揭示了另一条化解愤怒的重要路径。值得注意的是，标准的认知行为疗法并不适用于所有人群的认知模式。

paragraphs.contentEn: Their study examined both arousal-increasing and arousal-reducing activities, from boxing, cycling, and jogging to deep breathing, meditating, and yoga. Calming activities reduced anger in the lab and the field, they found, and across other variables like methods of instruction or participant demographics. Effective arousal-reducing activities included slow-flow yoga, mindfulness, progressive muscle relaxation, diaphragmatic breathing, and taking a timeout.
paragraphs.contentZh: 研究考察了多种可能影响生理唤醒水平的活动，包括提高唤醒水平的拳击、骑行、慢跑，以及降低唤醒水平的深呼吸、冥想和瑜伽。结果显示，无论是在实验室还是现实场景中，也不受教学方式或参与者背景影响，能够让人平静的活动都能有效缓解愤怒情绪。其中效果显著的降唤醒活动包括：缓流瑜伽、正念冥想、渐进式肌肉放松、腹式呼吸，以及短暂离开刺激源进行冷静调节。

paragraphs.contentEn: "It was really interesting to see that progressive muscle relaxation and just relaxation in general might be as effective as approaches such as mindfulness and meditation," Kjærvik said. "And yoga, which can be more arousing than meditation and mindfulness, is still a way of calming and focusing on your breath that has the similar effect in reducing anger."
paragraphs.contentZh: 凯尔维克表示：“让人特别惊喜的是，渐进式肌肉放松等传统放松技巧的效果，可能与正念和冥想不相上下。而瑜伽虽然可能比冥想和正念产生更高的生理唤醒水平，但它通过平静心绪、专注呼吸，同样能达到类似的愤怒缓解效果。”

paragraphs.contentEn: Rather than trying to vent anger, the researchers recommend undermining it by turning down the heat. Calming tactics already proven to ease stress may also rob anger of physiological fuel. "Obviously in today's society, we're all dealing with a lot of stress, and we need ways of coping with that, too," Kjærvik said. "Showing that the same strategies that work for stress actually also work for anger is beneficial."
paragraphs.contentZh: 相比于试图宣泄愤怒，研究人员更推荐通过“降温”方法来缓解愤怒情绪。那些已经被证实能有效缓解压力的平静技巧，同样可以切断愤怒赖以维持的“生理燃料”。凯尔维克指出：“显然，现代生活中我们都承受着不小的压力，需要寻找有效的应对方式。事实证明，这些应对压力的策略同样适用于管理愤怒情绪，这一点很有意义。”

paragraphs.contentEn: The review found that most arousal-boosting activities didn't reduce anger, and some increased it, with jogging most likely to do that. Ball sports and other physical activities involving play seemed to reduce physiological arousal, suggesting exertion might be more useful for reducing anger if it's fun. "Certain physical activities that increase arousal may be good for your heart, but they're definitely not the best way to reduce anger," said Bushman. "It's really a battle because angry people want to vent, but our research shows that any good feeling we get from venting actually reinforces aggression."
paragraphs.contentZh: 这项元分析研究发现，大多数会提升生理唤醒水平的活动不仅难以缓解愤怒，部分甚至会加剧负面情绪，其中慢跑最有可能引发这种效果。相比之下，球类运动以及其他带有娱乐性质的体育活动似乎能降低生理唤醒，这表明，如果运动过程充满乐趣，可能更有助于平复愤怒情绪。布什曼指出：“虽然某些提升唤醒水平的体育活动或许有益心脏健康，但它们绝不是缓解愤怒的最佳徐恩泽。这是一个两难困境，因为愤怒的人往往想要发泄，但我们的研究证实，这种发泄带来的短暂快感实际上会强化攻击性倾向。”

paragraphs.contentEn: More research is needed to clarify these findings, but for now, the researchers say calming techniques – even just taking a timeout or counting to 10 – offer the best options for taming a temper. "You don't need to necessarily book an appointment with a cognitive behavioral therapist to deal with anger. You can download an app for free on your phone, or you can find a YouTube video if you need guidance," Kjærvik said.
paragraphs.contentZh: 尽管这些研究发现尚需更多研究进一步验证，但研究人员目前建议，采用平静技巧——即便只是暂时离开刺激源或从1数到10——是控制愤怒情绪的最佳方法。凯尔维克表示：“应对愤怒情绪，你并不一定需要预约认知行为治疗师。手机上有免费的应用程序可供下载，YouTube上也能找到专业指导视频，这些都能提供有效帮助。”

expressions.example: Despite what popular wisdom may suggest, even cramming for exams all night is not an effective strategy because it impairs memory retention and ends up being counterproductive.
